digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and documentation discovery
propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a local checkout cannot resolve internal cross-references in packaged guides because they use consumer-relative paths instead of hosted URLs or rebar explain commands
The required commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT) has no CLI-discoverable home; it exists only in verify-commit-ticket help and verify_commit.py, with no rebar explain topic
All dangling references in packaged guides must be repointed to use either https://github.com/navapbc/rebar hosted URLs or rebar explain <topic> commands for sibling guides
A guard test must prevent regression by asserting no packaged guide link target is a consumer-relative path, allowing only https://, http://, #anchors, or mailto:
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring hardcodes the guide list (plan/review) and must be updated to include commit-trailer so MCP clients discover it
